# Coverage-gate waivers — a one-way RATCHET, not a parking lot.
#
# Each line is surface (a CLI command or an API operation) that has NO referencing
# test yet. The coverage gate (cmd/dejima/coverage_gate_test.go) credits these as
# "known, tracked gaps" so the gate is green, while still FAILING on any NEW
# untested command/op that is not listed here.
#
# Rules enforced by the gate itself:
#   - Add a test for an entry, then DELETE its line. (A waived entry that gains a
#     test is flagged as a STALE waiver and fails CI — the ratchet only tightens.)
#   - A line that matches no current command/op is an ORPHAN waiver and fails CI.
#   - Adding a NEW line is a deliberate, reviewed act — prefer writing the test.
#
# Format:  cli <command path>        e.g.  cli agent config
#          api <METHOD> <path>       e.g.  api POST /v1/islands/{name}/hibernate
#
# See docs/testing/coverage-gate.md.
#
# The entries below are host-mutating, interactive, or network-bound and cannot
# be exercised hermetically in CI (no Docker, no real macOS host, no terminal).
# They are owned by the live tier-3 suites on the Mac-mini runner — see
# scripts/tier3/ and docs/testing/test-coverage-matrix.md §13/§14/§15.

cli auth push         # pushes host Claude/GitHub creds — needs a logged-in host
cli onboard           # --provision-host wizard mutates the macOS host (tier3)
cli service uninstall # removes the launchd/systemd daemon service (tier3)
cli ssh enroll        # writes client SSH keys + ~/.ssh/config on the host
cli tui               # launches the interactive bubbletea TUI (teatest covers the model)
cli uninstall         # removes the installed dejima binary + service from the host
cli update            # self-update: queries GitHub releases + replaces the binary
